prompt: The discovery of the ancient manuscript was considered ______; not only did it provide a missing link in the region's history, but it also debunked several long-held myths.

options.A: redundant
options.B: pivotal
options.C: marginal
options.D: trivial
options.E: obsolete

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Pivotal' (hayati, kilit noktada, çok önemli) sıfatı, cümlenin devamındaki 'missing link' (kayıp halka) ve 'debunked myths' (mitleri çürütmek) ifadeleriyle tam bir anlam bütünlüğü kurar.

prompt: The scientist urged caution, arguing that the current evidence is too ______ to justify sweeping claims about the new drug's safety.

options.A: inevitable
options.B: fragmentary
options.C: lucid
options.D: robust
options.E: cordial

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Fragmentary' (parça parça, eksik, yetersiz). Büyük iddiaları (sweeping claims) desteklemek için kanıtların henüz 'tamamlanmamış' olduğu vurgulanmaktadır.

prompt: The new environmental regulations are intended to ______ the process of industrial waste management, ensuring stricter adherence to safety protocols.

options.A: complicate
options.B: hinder
options.C: facilitate
options.D: streamline
options.E: stagnate

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Streamline' (modernize etmek, daha verimli hale getirmek). Sürecin iyileştirilmesi ve protokollere uyumun artırılması için 'düzene koymak' anlamı en uygundur.

prompt: The CEO's ______ lifestyle stood in stark contrast to the company’s struggling finances and the recent wave of employee layoffs.

options.A: frugal
options.B: ostentatious
options.C: modest
options.D: austere
options.E: prudent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Ostentatious' (gösterişli, şatafatlı). Şirketin mali zorlukları ve işten çıkarmalarla zıtlık (contrast) oluşturan şey aşırı lüks yaşamdır.

prompt: Facing a sudden ______ of applicants, the HR department had to revise its initial screening process to manage the volume effectively.

options.A: scarcity
options.B: influx
options.C: dearth
options.D: void
options.E: depletion

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Influx' (akın, istila, yoğun geliş). Başvuranların yoğun bir şekilde gelmesi (volume) durumunu niteleyen en iyi kelimedir.

prompt: The diplomat was praised for his ______ handling of the crisis, which prevented a minor border dispute from escalating into a full-scale war.

options.A: clumsy
options.B: rash
options.C: adept
options.D: reckless
options.E: indifferent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Adept' (becerikli, usta). Krizi başarıyla yönetip savaşı önleyen bir diplomat için kullanılan olumlu sıfattır.

prompt: Not until the implementation of the new carbon tax ______ significant progress in the reduction of industrial emissions across the continent.

options.A: there was
options.B: did there be
options.C: was there
options.D: has there been
options.E: there had been

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not until' yapısı cümle başında devrik (Inversion) yapı gerektirir. Geçmişe atıf için 'was there' doğrudur.

prompt: It is imperative that the judicial system ______ its independence from political influence to maintain public trust in the law.

options.A: upholds
options.B: uphold
options.C: upholding
options.D: to uphold
options.E: is upholding

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is imperative that' yapısı Subjunctive gerektirir. Fiil her zaman yalın (bare infinitive) kalır; 'uphold' doğrudur.

prompt: The suspect is alleged ______ confidential information to foreign agents long before the official investigation began.

options.A: to leak
options.B: to have leaked
options.C: leaking
options.D: to be leaking
options.E: having leaked

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is alleged' yapısından sonra eylem geçmişte bittiği için (long before) Perfect Infinitive (to have + V3) kullanılır.

prompt: Should the volatile chemicals ______ to extreme heat, a catastrophic explosion is almost inevitable.

options.A: expose
options.B: be exposed
options.C: to be exposed
options.D: exposing
options.E: have exposed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Should' devrik Type 1. Kimyasallar maruz 'kalacağı' (pasif) için 'be exposed' (yalın pasif) kullanılır.

prompt: Little ______ the inventors realize that their discovery ______ the entire field of quantum physics in the years to follow.

options.A: did / would revolutionize
options.B: have / will revolutionize
options.C: do / has revolutionized
options.D: had / was revolutionizing
options.E: were / had revolutionized

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Little' zarfı başta devrik yapı ister (did ... realize). Geçmişten geleceğe bakış 'would' (future in the past) ile verilir.

prompt: Rarely ______ a single individual had such a profound impact on the direction of global economic policy.

options.A: we encounter
options.B: do we encounter
options.C: has
options.D: we have encountered
options.E: have we

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rarely' (Inversion). Cümlede 'had' (V3) olduğu için yardımcı fiil 'has' devrilmiştir.

prompt: By the time the new regulations ______ next month, most corporations ______ their internal compliance systems.

options.A: are implemented / will have changed
options.B: will be implemented / have changed
options.C: were implemented / had changed
options.D: are implemented / will change
options.E: implement / would have changed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'By the time + Present Simple, Future Perfect (will have V3)' kalıbı. Gelecekte bir ana kadar tamamlanmış olacak eylemler için kullanılır.

prompt: No sooner ______ the satellite reached its orbit ______ it began transmitting high-resolution data back to Earth.

options.A: had / than
options.B: did / when
options.C: had / when
options.D: was / that
options.E: has / then

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No sooner ... than' (yapar yapmaz) kalıbı devrik dizilim (had + S + V3) ile kullanılır.

prompt: Had the engineers ______ the bridge's structural integrity earlier, the collapse ______ successfully.

options.A: assessed / could have been prevented
options.B: assess / could be prevented
options.C: assessed / would prevent
options.D: assessing / had been prevented
options.E: assess / might prevent

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devriği (Had + S + V3). Geçmişteki hayali sonuç pasif olduğu için 'could have been prevented' doğrudur.

prompt: The more ______ the economic data becomes, the more ______ the market is to react to even the smallest policy shifts.

options.A: volatile / likely
options.B: volatily / likelier
options.C: volatile / likelily
options.D: volatility / likelihood
options.E: volatily / likely

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'The more ... the more' yapısında her iki taraf da sıfat (adjective) olmalıdır.

prompt: Many assume that scientific consensus emerges simply by accumulating facts. (17) ______, consensus also depends on shared standards...

options.A: Therefore
options.B: Likewise
options.C: However
options.D: Namely
options.E: Consequently

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bir önceki cümledeki genel varsayıma zıt bir durum sunulduğu için zıtlık bağlacı 'However' (Ancak) gereklidir.

prompt: ...standards: which methods count (18) ______ reliable, how uncertainty is reported, and what replication thresholds are required.

options.A: to
options.B: at
options.C: by
options.D: as
options.E: for

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Count as' (olarak kabul edilmek/sayılmak) kalıplaşmış bir phrasal verb kullanımıdır.

prompt: When standards differ across fields, findings may (19) ______ in incompatible ways.

options.A: interpret
options.B: be interpreted
options.C: interpreting
options.D: interpreted
options.E: be interpreting

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bulgular (findings) kendi kendini yorumlayamaz, yorumlanır (pasif). Modaldan sonra yalın pasif: 'may be interpreted'.

prompt: Thus, consensus is as much about common criteria (20) ______ it is about data.

options.A: as
options.B: than
options.C: that
options.D: so
options.E: but

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'As much ... as ...' (kadar) karşılaştırma yapısı kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Without bu kriterler, scientific progress would be (21) ______ by endless debates.

options.A: facilitated
options.B: stymied
options.C: catalyzed
options.D: bolstered
options.E: expedited

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Stymie' (engellemek, sekteye uğratmak). Tartışmalar ilerlemeyi engelleyeceği için anlamca en uygun kelimedir.

prompt: Remote work has expanded rapidly, (22) ______ flexibility and reducing commuting time.

options.A: offering
options.B: to offer
options.C: offered
options.D: having offered
options.E: being offered

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Genişlemenin bir sonucu olarak aktif '-ing' kısaltması (sunarak) kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Yet it may also blur boundaries between work and personal life, (23) ______ to burnout.

options.A: lead
options.B: leading
options.C: to lead
options.D: led
options.E: leads

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Leading to' (yol açarak). Sürecin bir sonucunu niteleyen participle kısaltmasıdır.

prompt: (24) ______ benefits are unevenly distributed, technological progress can widen inequality.

options.A: Whether
options.B: Unless
options.C: When
options.D: Despite
options.E: Until

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'When' (-dığında/-dığı zaman). Koşul ve zaman belirten, bağlama en uygun bağlaçtır.

prompt: Policymakers must ensure that regulations (25) ______ to protect vulnerable workers.

options.A: are strengthened
options.B: strengthen
options.C: strengthened
options.D: be strengthening
options.E: strengthening

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kuralların (regulations) güçlendirilmesi (edilgen) gerektiği için Present Simple Passive kullanılmıştır.

prompt: Success depends on (26) ____ accountability and innovation are balanced correctly.

options.A: how
options.B: what
options.C: which
options.D: who
options.E: why

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Dengelemenin 'nasıl' (how) yapıldığına bağlı olduğunu belirten Noun Clause bağlacıdır.

prompt: Despite the fact that the company reported a record profit this year, ______.

options.A: it has decided to hire more staff in every department
options.B: several senior executives have been forced to resign due to misconduct
options.C: stock prices are expected to reach an all-time high tomorrow
options.D: it is planning to expand its operations into the Asian market
options.E: most investors are highly satisfied with the current management

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Despite' zıtlık ister. Kâra rağmen 'yöneticilerin istifası' (olumsuz durum) anlamca tamdır.

prompt: Unless the international community takes immediate action to curb carbon emissions, ______.

options.A: many endangered species will have a chance to survive
options.B: global warming might be slowed down significantly
options.C: we will witness an irreversible loss of biodiversity
options.D: forest areas will expand more than ever before
options.E: the targets set in the Paris Agreement will be easily met

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unless' (-mezse) olumsuz bir koşul sunar; aksiyon alınmazsa 'geri dönülemez kayıp' yaşanacaktır.

prompt: No matter how hard the rescue team tried to reach the trapped hikers, ______.

options.A: the weather conditions improved just in time
options.B: they were able to save everyone safely
options.C: the thick fog made it impossible to locate them
options.D: it was a very successful mission for all involved
options.E: the hikers were found in good health

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'No matter how hard' (ne kadar uğraşsalar da) zıtlık/başarısızlık beklentisi yaratır.

prompt: While some critics argue that digital technology isolates people, ______.

options.A: it often leads to shorter attention spans among students
options.B: it clearly facilitates global communication and community building
options.C: privacy concerns are becoming more prevalent nowadays
options.D: many apps are designed to be addictive for users
options.E: social media has many negative impacts on mental health

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'While' zıtlık bağlacıdır. İzolasyon iddiasına karşı 'küresel iletişimi kolaylaştırma' zıtlığı kurar.

prompt: So complex was the structural defect in the bridge ______.

options.A: even the most experienced engineers couldn't find a solution
options.B: that it required years of intensive restoration work
options.C: when it was first inspected by the city officials
options.D: because the materials used were of very low quality
options.E: although it appeared perfectly safe from the outside

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'So ... that' kalıbı. Defekt o kadar karmaşıktı ki 'şuna yol açtı' (that) şeklinde tamamlanmalıdır.

prompt: ______ for the timely discovery of the tumor, the patient would not have had a good chance of recovery.

options.A: If it were not
options.B: Had it not been
options.C: Unless it was
options.D: Even if it had been
options.E: Provided it was

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Type 3 Conditional devriği: 'Had it not been for' (olmasaydı).

prompt: Only after months of intense deliberation ______ to approve the controversial land development project.

options.A: the council agreed
options.B: did the council agree
options.C: the council had agreed
options.D: has the council agreed
options.E: the council was agreed

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Only after' başta devrik yapı (Inversion) ister (did ... agree).

prompt: The novel, whose plot is based on real historical events, ______.

options.A: is often criticized for being too predictable
options.B: has been translated into over thirty languages
options.C: who was written by a famous author in the 19th century
options.D: it provides a unique perspective on the Great Depression
options.E: which gained immense popularity shortly after its release

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Ana özne 'the novel' dır. Relative clause bittikten sonra ana fiil (has been translated) gelmelidir.

prompt: It is recommended that anyone planning to visit the tropical region ______.

options.A: takes all necessary vaccinations before departure
options.B: take all necessary vaccinations before departure
options.C: to take all necessary vaccinations before departure
options.D: taking all necessary vaccinations before departure
options.E: should have taken all necessary vaccinations

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'It is recommended that' Subjunctive yapısıdır, fiil her zaman yalın (take) kalır.

prompt: Rather than spending all their budget on aggressive marketing campaigns, ______.

options.A: the company should consider investing in product development
options.B: luxury brands have increased their prices significantly recently
options.C: marketing is essential for any business to thrive
options.D: they bought a new office in the city center last month
options.E: the target audience prefers traditional forms of advertising

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rather than' (yerine) bir tercih sunar.

prompt: Bu yaklaşım, kısa vadeli kazançlar yerine sürdürülebilir büyümeyi hedefler.

options.A: This approach aims for sustainable growth rather than short-term gains.
options.B: This approach rejects growth in every form for short-term profit.
options.C: Sustainable growth is as important as short-term gains.
options.D: This approach focuses only on short-term profit.
options.E: Short-term gains are targeted by this approach.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Rather than' (yerine) ve 'aim for' (hedeflemek) yapıları cümlenin tam karşılığıdır.

prompt: İnternetin yaygınlaşmasıyla birlikte, bilgiye erişim hızı artsa da bilginin doğruluğunu teyit etmek zorlaşmıştır.

options.A: Confirming information is hard even though the internet is common.
options.B: With the widespread use of the internet, although the speed of access to information has increased, it has become harder to verify its accuracy.
options.C: The internet has increased information speed, but verification is hard.
options.D: Accessing information is faster now, but confirming it is difficult.
options.E: Although the internet is common, accuracy is not important.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Cümlenin tüm öğeleri (yaygınlaşmasıyla, artsa da, teyit etmek) B şıkkında mevcuttur.

prompt: Ekonomik krizle başa çıkabilmek için hükümet, kamu harcamalarını azaltmak ve yerel üretimi desteklemek zorundadır.

options.A: The government must reduce public spending and support local production to cope with the economic crisis.
options.B: To solve the crisis, the government should focus on production.
options.C: Reducing public spending is the only way to support production.
options.D: The government has reduced spending to support production.
options.E: Although there is a crisis, the government continues production.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Cope with' (başa çıkmak) ve 'must' (zorunda) anahtar kelimelerdir.

prompt: Despite the heavy rain, the football match was not postponed, which surprised the fans.

options.A: Şiddetli yağmura rağmen futbol maçının ertelenmemesi taraftarları şaşırttı.
options.B: Yağmur şiddetli olduğu için maçın ertelenmesini bekliyorlardı.
options.C: Maç ertelenmedi çünkü taraftarlar yağmura rağmen gelmişti.
options.D: Taraftarlar maçın ertelenmemesine şaşırdılar ama maçı izlediler.
options.E: Maçın ertelenmesi taraftarları şaşırttı çünkü yağmur azdı.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Despite' (rağmen), 'postpone' (erteleme) kavramları A şıkkında doğrudur.

prompt: The new project aims to provide clean water to rural areas where people suffer from water scarcity.

options.A: Su kıtlığı çeken insanlar için kırsal bölgelerde yeni bir proje başladı.
options.B: Yeni proje, insanların su kıtlığı çektiği kırsal bölgelere temiz su sağlamayı amaçlamaktadır.
options.C: Kırsal bölgelerdeki su kıtlığı sorunu çözülmeye çalışılıyor.
options.D: Bu projenin amacı, su kıtlığı olan yerlerde temiz su bulmaktır.
options.E: Temiz su sağlamak amacıyla başlatılan proje kırsal kesimi hedefliyor.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Aim to' (amaçlamak) ve 'rural areas' (kırsal bölgeler) B şıkkında doğru verilmiştir.

prompt: Son araştırmalar, düzenli egzersiz yapmanın sadece fiziksel sağlığı iyileştirmekle kalmayıp aynı zamanda stresi de azalttığını göstermektedir.

options.A: Regular exercise is good for physical health and stress.
options.B: Recent research shows that doing regular exercise not only improves physical health but also reduces stress.
options.C: If you want to improve health, you should do exercise.
options.D: Research proven that stress can be reduced by exercise.
options.E: Not only stress but also physical health can be improved.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Not only ... but also' (sadece ... değil aynı zamanda ...) yapısı Türkçedeki vurguyu tam karşılar.

prompt: According to the passage, the primary reason for the decline in bee populations is ______.

options.A: the natural aging process of bee colonies
options.B: environmental factors such as pesticide use and habitat loss
options.C: an increase in the global production of nuts and fruits
options.D: the migration of bees to urban areas for better food
options.E: a lack of interest in traditional beekeeping methods

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Pasaj Arılar üzerinedir). Metinde pestisit (pesticide) ve yaşam alanı kaybı (habitat loss) vurgulanmıştır.

prompt: The author implies that without bees, global food security ______.

options.A: would remain unaffected due to modern technology
options.B: could be severely compromised due to a lack of pollination
options.C: would improve as farmers switch to other crops
options.D: is only a concern for people in developing nations
options.E: will depend solely on the use of wind-pollinated plants

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Arıların yokluğunun tozlaşmayı (pollination) bitirip gıda güvenliğini tehlikeye atacağı (compromised) belirtilmiştir.

prompt: In the context of the passage, the term 'efficiency' in policy is often ______.

options.A: misunderstood as a purely ethical goal
options.B: presented as a neutral and objective target
options.C: used to justify the equal distribution of wealth
options.D: rejected by economists as a vague concept
options.E: limited to the measurement of time saved

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: (Pasaj Politika Verimliliği üzerinedir). Verimliliğin genelde 'tarafsız/objektif' (neutral) bir hedef olarak sunulduğu metinde geçer.

prompt: The passage suggests that debates about efficiency cannot be separated from ______.

options.A: the cost of initial infrastructure
options.B: questions regarding fairness and equity
options.C: the speed of technological advancement
options.D: the geographic location of the population
options.E: the personal preferences of policymakers

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Verimlilik ve adalet/hakkaniyet (fairness/equity) arasındaki ayrılmaz bağ vurgulanmıştır.

prompt: The author argue that scientific consensus is built upon ______.

options.A: the simple accumulation of raw data and facts
options.B: shared standards and criteria within the community
options.C: ignoring uncertainty to reach quicker agreements
options.D: political pressure from government funding agencies
options.E: the elimination of all peer-review processes

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Fikir birliğinin (consensus) 'ortak kriterlere' (shared standards) dayandığı savunulur.

prompt: According to the passage, findings across different fields may be incompatible because ______.

options.A: the equipment used is often outdated
options.B: researchers use different thresholds and standards
options.C: there is too much focus on uncertainty reporting
options.D: most data is now collected automatically by AI
options.E: publication speed has decreased in recent years

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Uyumsuzluğun nedeni 'farklı standartlar' (different thresholds) olarak açıklanmıştır.

prompt: Remote work expanded rapidly mainly because it ______.

options.A: guarantees that all employees work longer hours
options.B: offers flexibility and eliminates commuting time
options.C: completely removes all sources of workplace stress
options.D: is the only way to ensure high levels of privacy
options.E: requires no technical training for the staff

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Esneklik (flexibility) ve yol süresi (commuting) avantajları metinde vurgulanmıştır.

prompt: The author cautions that remote work might ______.

options.A: make office buildings completely obsolete within a year
options.B: blur the boundaries between professional and personal life
options.C: only be useful for people in the tech industry
options.D: increase the cost of energy for most corporations
options.E: prevent any form of teamwork among employees

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İş ve özel hayat sınırlarının bulanıklaşması (blur boundaries) temel risktir.

prompt: The passage states that traditional energy sources like coal and oil are ______.

options.A: essential for reducing the impact of global warming
options.B: the primary drivers behind the current climate crisis
options.C: renewable if managed with modern technology
options.D: more reliable and cleaner than solar energy
options.E: the only focus of modern energy policy research

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Kömür ve petrolün iklim krizinin 'baş aktörü' (primary drivers) olduğu belirtilmiştir.

prompt: It can be inferred from the passage that the cost of renewable energy infrastructure ______.

options.A: is negligible compared to traditional sources
options.B: is high initially but justified by long-term benefits
options.C: will always remain too high for developing nations
options.D: is the main reason why global warming is increasing
options.E: is no longer a concern for modern governments

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Maliyetin başta yüksek olduğu (high initially) ancak uzun vadeli faydaların (long-term benefits) ağır bastığı ifade edilir.

prompt: The author implies that digital misinformation ______.

options.A: is a transient problem that will solve itself
options.B: threatens the very foundation of democratic discourse
options.C: is only spread by people who lack technical skills
options.D: has been eliminated by social media moderation
options.E: is more prevalent in print media than online

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Dijital yanlış bilginin demokratik tartışma zeminini (foundation of discourse) tehdit ettiği anlatılır.

prompt: According to the passage, combating misinformation requires ______.

options.A: the total censorship of all online news sources
options.B: promoting digital literacy and shared verification standards
options.C: ignoring all news that is not from official agencies
options.D: reducing the speed of internet access globally
options.E: allowing all users to share any information freely

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Dijital okuryazarlık (digital literacy) ve doğrulama (verification) çözümdür.

prompt: One impact of AI on the workforce mentioned in the passage is ______.

options.A: the total removal of the need for human management
options.B: the automation of routine and repetitive tasks
options.C: an increase in the number of traditional manufacturing jobs
options.D: a decrease in the demand for technical and digital skills
options.E: the complete elimination of inequality in every sector

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: YZ'nin rutin görevleri (routine tasks) otomatize etmesi yaygın bir etkidir.

prompt: The transition to an AI-driven economy requires workers to ______.

options.A: acquire new skills to remain competitive in the market
options.B: expect the government to eliminate all automation
options.C: focus only on jobs that existed before the tech boom
options.D: reject any form of technical training in the office
options.E: ignore the long-term impacts of technological shifts

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Yeni beceriler edinme (acquire new skills) ihtiyacı vurgulanır.

prompt: The main theme of the passage is ______.

options.A: the history of ancient archeological excavations
options.B: the relationship between technology, work, and social equity
options.C: the chemical properties of volatile substances in labs
options.D: the benefits of traditional beekeeping in rural areas
options.E: the failure of modern diplomatic negotiations

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Teknoloji, iş ve toplumsal eşitlik (equity) arasındaki ilişki ana temadır.

prompt: Income disparity has increased partly because ______.

options.A: technological benefits are distributed equally to everyone
options.B: current tax and economic policies favor high-income groups
options.C: there is a global decrease in the demand for skilled labor
options.D: most people prefer lower-paying jobs with less stress
options.E: small businesses are no longer affected by global markets

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Politikaların yüksek gelirlileri (high-income groups) kayırması eşitsizliğin bir nedenidir.

prompt: The author suggests that a failure to address income inequality ______.

options.B: could result in widespread social unrest and instability
options.C: is not a major concern for modern developed nations
options.D: can be solved by increasing the hours of the workday
options.E: will happen automatically through technological progress

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Eşitsizliğin toplumsal huzursuzluğa (unrest) yol açacağı belirtilmiştir.

prompt: Democratic discourse is vulnerable when ______.

options.A: the speed of internet access is too high for users
options.B: misinformation undermines the accuracy of shared data
options.C: all information is verified by multiple independent sources
options.D: users spend less time on social media platforms
options.E: the cost of digital devices remains stable over time

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Yanlış bilginin veri doğruluğunu sarsması (undermine accuracy) demokrasiyi kırılgan yapar.

prompt: According to the passage, the Renaissance focused on ______.

options.A: abstract concepts rather than the human form
options.B: realism and the innovative use of perspective
options.C: rejecting any form of financial support from merchants
options.D: the total elimination of traditional artistic techniques
options.E: focusing only on religious themes without any realism

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Rönesans'ın gerçekçilik (realism) ve perspektif odaklı olduğu belirtilir.

prompt: The author suggests that income disparity ______.

options.A: is inevitable and should not be questioned in policy
options.B: requires careful policy intervention to be reduced
options.C: will increase automatically as more people get degrees
options.D: is only a problem during periods of economic boom
options.E: can be solved by decreasing the number of urban workers

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Eşitsizliğin politika müdahalesi (policy intervention) gerektirdiği savunulur.

prompt:
Sarah: Have you noticed how many startups are failing lately?
Mark: Yes, it seems the initial hype isn't enough to sustain them.
Sarah: ______.
Mark: Exactly. A realistic budget is often missing in their plans.

options.A: Many of them have great ideas, though
options.B: They often underestimate the importance of stable funding
options.C: Innovation is the key to their long-term success
options.D: The founders are usually quite experienced
options.E: Marketing is where they spend most of their money

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Sarah, Mark'ın bütçe vurgusunu destekleyen 'finansal kaynak/fonlama' (stable funding) uyarısını yapmalıdır.

prompt:
Teacher: Why is peer review so important in science?
Student: It ensures that research is evaluated by experts before publication.
Teacher: ______.
Student: That's true, it acts as a filter for errors and biases.

options.A: So, any scientist can publish their findings immediately
options.B: It basically prevents flawed data from being accepted as fact
options.C: Does it also help in getting more funding for the project?
options.D: Many researchers find the process too time-consuming
options.E: The number of reviewers depends on the field of study

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Öğretmen, 'hatalı verinin gerçek olarak kabulünü önleme' (prevent flawed data) diyerek süreci özetler.

prompt:
Jane: I'm finding it hard to separate work from my personal life while working remotely.
Tom: I had the same issue until I created a dedicated workspace.
Jane: ______.
Tom: It really does. It tells your brain that the workday is officially over.

options.A: I don't think I have enough space in my apartment
options.B: Maybe having a physical boundary is what I need
options.C: Do you think that actually makes a difference in your focus?
options.D: My coworkers often call me after office hours anyway
options.E: I prefer working from the couch as it is more comfortable

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Fiziksel sınır' (physical boundary) kavramı, Tom'un 'beyne iş bitti sinyali' açıklamasıyla örtüşür.

prompt:
Officer: Can you describe the person you saw leaving the building?
Witness: It was dark, so I only saw a tall figure in a dark coat.
Officer: ______.
Witness: No, I couldn't even see the color of their hair.

options.A: Did they seem to be in a hurry?
options.B: Were you able to notice any distinguishing features?
options.C: Was there anyone else around at that time?
options.D: How long did you stay at the scene after that?
options.E: Did you report this to anyone else before calling us?

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Şahidin 'saç rengini bile göremedim' demesi, polisin 'ayırt edici özellik' (distinguishing features) sorusuna cevaptır.

prompt:
Reporter: The public is concerned about the new tax policy.
Minister: We understand, but it is necessary for long-term stability.
Reporter: ______.
Minister: We have introduced subsidies to mitigate that impact.

options.A: The policy has been praised by many economic experts
options.B: Won't this disproportionately affect low-income families?
options.C: When will the new regulations come into effect?
options.D: The government is planning to reduce public spending
options.E: Is there any other way to ensure economic recovery?

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: Bakanın 'etkiyi azaltmak için sübvansiyon getirdik' demesi, muhabirin 'dar gelirliler üzerindeki orantısız etki' sorusuna bir yanıttır.

prompt: The minister’s assurances sounded confident, but analysts found them unconvincing because they ignored key economic indicators.

options.A: Analysts were not persuaded by the minister's confident talk as he failed to consider important economic data.
options.B: The minister was not confident about the economic indicators, which analysts also pointed out.
options.C: Important economic data were ignored by the minister despite the analysts' convincing arguments.
options.D: Confidence was lacking in the minister's assurances, so analysts rejected the report.
options.E: Analysts found the minister's talk unconvincing even though he addressed every key indicator.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Unconvincing' (not persuaded) ve 'ignored key indicators' (failed to consider data) eşleşmesi A'da tamdır.

prompt: Technological progress can improve living standards, yet it can also widen inequality if benefits are unevenly distributed.

options.A: Living standards only improve when the benefits are shared equally among all people.
options.B: Although technology may enhance how we live, it might also increase the gap between people if distributed unfairly.
options.C: Technological advancement always leads to greater inequality regardless of distribution.
options.D: Inequality is a natural result of technology, so living standards do not really improve.
options.E: Progress in technology is necessary to reduce inequality and improve standards.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Yet' (although), 'widen inequality' (increase the gap) ve 'unevenly' (unfairly) kelime takasları anlamı korumuştur.

prompt: The suspect is believed to have leaked confidential documents to a rival company long before the investigation began.

options.A: The investigation started because the suspect was caught leaking documents.
options.B: It is thought that the suspect shared secret files with another firm well before the official probe started.
options.C: Documents were leaked only after the investigation into the suspect had begun.
options.D: Before the investigation, the suspect was believed to be innocent of sharing secret information.
options.E: A rival company helped the suspect leak confidential documents during the probe.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Is believed' (is thought), 'confidential' (secret) ve 'investigation' (probe) eşleşmeleri doğrudur.

prompt: The committee insisted on reviewing the raw data before approving the final report to ensure its accuracy.

options.A: To make sure the report was correct, the committee demanded to see the original data prior to giving their approval.
options.B: The final report was approved even though the raw data were found to be inaccurate.
options.C: Reviewing raw data is the only way for the committee to guarantee approval.
options.D: Accuracy was not a concern for the committee as long as data were provided.
options.E: The committee approved the report because the raw data had already been reviewed.

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Insisted on' (demanded), 'ensure accuracy' (make sure correct) ve 'before' (prior to) A'yı doğru yapar.

prompt: In the world of finance, some risks are quantifiable and can be predicted with accuracy. ______. These unforeseen events often have the most significant impact on the market.

options.A: Mathematical models are used to calculate potential losses
options.B: However, others are completely unpredictable and catch experts by surprise
options.C: Investors usually prefer stable and low-risk assets
options.D: Therefore, most people choose to invest in well-known companies
options.E: The goal of every analyst is to eliminate risk entirely

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: 'Bazı riskler öngörülebilir' ifadesinden sonra 'ancak diğerleri öngörülemez' (unpredictable) zıtlığı gelmelidir.

prompt: Ancient architecture often reflects the social hierarchy of the time. Temples were built to dwarf the common people. ______. Even today, these structures evoke a sense of awe.

options.A: Building materials were usually sourced from local quarries
options.B: The use of scale and perspective was a deliberate psychological tool
options.C: Many commoners were employed as skilled laborers
options.D: The preservation of these sites is a challenge for governments
options.E: Archaeologists are still discovering new layers beneath buildings

explanation: ÇÖZÜM: İnsanları küçük gösterme çabası 'bilinçli bir psikolojik araç' (deliberate psychological tool) olarak nitelenir.

prompt: Digital literacy is no longer optional. Most roles require proficiency with various software. ______. As a result, those who lack these skills face barriers to employment.

options.C: This shift has fundamentally changed how we perceive stability
options.D: Traditional education systems are struggling with this demand
options.E: The cost of hardware has decreased significantly recently

prompt: Scientific consensus is built upon shared standards. Findings must be peer-reviewed multiple times. ______. It ensures that only the most robust ideas become part of established knowledge.
